subject: Marketplace usage allocation — July payout shortfall / entity split investigation
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 5 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace payout mismatch for July — first pass

Hi Rachel / Marcus,

Quick heads up — I pulled the July marketplace reporting and there’s a ~€4,950 gap between the AWS Marketplace invoice (Invoice MKT-2028-07-8891) and the payout we received from the marketplace settlement. AWS invoiced €18,450 for product redwood-inference/prod-x but our settlement shows a payout of €13,500.

Preliminary notes:
- Many of the high-value line items are EU customers (BrightWave Analytics, three subscriptions).
- The usage file includes multiple MerchantTokens; looks like some traffic is attributed to CloudReseller Inc (merchant token ends in -CR123).
- If AWS has split sales across our direct merchant account and the reseller account, the VAT treatment and commissions will differ.

I attached our usage export and a simple pivot. Can you take point with AWS and CloudReseller to get the mapping from marketplace entitlements -> merchant token so we can reconcile? Also flagging Accounting in case we need to hold a partial payout while this is investigated.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-marketplace-usage-export-Jul-2028.csv (export of meter lines, product_code, buyer, merchant_token, quantity, line_total_eur)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: aws-marketplace-billing@amazon.com, accounts@cloudreseller.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Aug 2028 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace usage allocation — July payout shortfall / entity split investigation

Hello AWS Marketplace Billing team and CloudReseller accounts,

We discovered a discrepancy between Invoice MKT-2028-07-8891 and the settlement Redwood received for July. It appears some transactions for our product redwood-inference/prod-x were attributed to a reseller merchant token (CloudReseller), which reduced our direct payout. We need the following from AWS and CloudReseller to reconcile and determine if a correction is required: 

1) A mapping file for July that shows meter usage lines with the following fields: marketplace_invoice_id, marketplace_entitlement_id, merchant_token, buyer_account, line_item_amount_eur, tax_eur.
2) Confirmation whether CloudReseller submitted any retrospective adjustments or repricing requests for July usage.
3) The AWS invoice line items PDF and the S3 path to the raw billing CSV for the invoice (we were given Invoice MKT-2028-07-8891 but not the per-line CSV).
4) For EU buyers, please confirm tax/VAT handling used for each line (who was treated as the supplier for VAT).

Karthik attached a usage export (redwood-marketplace-usage-export-Jul-2028.csv). Marcus — Accounting would like to know if we should issue a provisional credit memo to BrightWave while AWS/CloudReseller reconcile.

Rachel Kim
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: redwood-marketplace-usage-export-Jul-2028.csv

--- Forwarded message attached below ---

From: AWS Marketplace Billing <aws-marketplace-billing@amazon.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@cloudreseller.com
Date: Mon, 6 Aug 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace usage allocation — July payout shortfall / entity split investigation

Hi Rachel and team,

Thanks for the report — we’ve opened Case AMZ-MKT-168332 on your behalf. To move quickly, please confirm the following so we can pull the detailed per-line records:

• MerchantToken(s) (you provided one ending -CR123; please list any others)
• Marketplace Account ID (your merchant id) and any reseller merchant ids to include
• The invoice number(s) of interest: MKT-2028-07-8891

We can provide the per-line CSV and the invoice line item PDF. Regarding VAT: we record the supplier based on the merchant_token used at the time of purchase; if transactions were processed under CloudReseller’s merchant_token they will be reflected on CloudReseller’s settlement and may be subject to reseller-specific VAT handling. If you’d like us to initiate a redistribution request we can, but it requires a documented mapping and may trigger adjustments on both merchant accounts.

Next steps: please upload the redwood CSV (you already attached it to the thread) and list any additional merchant tokens. We’ll return the per-line CSV and pdf within 48 business hours and include the entitlements->merchant_token mapping.

Case link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/AMZ-MKT-168332

Regards,
Jamie Chen
AWS Marketplace Billing Operations
aws-marketplace-billing@amazon.com

Attachment: aws-case-168332-invoice-lines.pdf (stub of invoice lines we will share)

From: CloudReseller Inc. <accounts@cloudreseller.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, aws-marketplace-billing@amazon.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Aug 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace usage allocation — July payout shortfall / entity split investigation

Hi Rachel / AWS,

We confirm that some BrightWave subscriptions were transacted under our reseller merchant token (CR-6789-CR123). I’ve attached our allocation report for July which shows the invoice ids and purchaser emails we see on our end. We submitted a redistribution request to AWS on Aug 6 (ref AMZ-MKT-168332) to move the affected lines to Redwood’s merchant_token where the buyer elected direct supplier treatment.

If AWS approves the redistribution, it will generate adjustments on both settlement statements and may change VAT treatment for the affected buyers. We’ll share any updated settlement once AWS processes the request.

Best,
Asha Rao
Revenue Ops — CloudReseller Inc.
accounts@cloudreseller.com

Attachment: cloudreseller-allocation-Jul-2028.csv (reseller allocation report)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Aug 2028 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace usage allocation — July payout shortfall / entity split investigation

Thanks for the updates. Proposed reconciliation plan:

1) Wait for AWS to return per-line CSV and their entitlement->merchant_token mapping (AWS ETA 48 business hours).
2) If redistribution is approved, request AWS provide the debit/credit memos and revised settlement report.
3) For any impacted EU invoices where VAT treatment changes, Accounting will calculate net of VAT amounts and prepare adjustment entries; recommend holding €5,000 of the August payout as a contingency until we have final numbers.
4) If CloudReseller cannot confirm buyer consent for supplier change, we should prepare credit memos to customers and issue refunds where appropriate.

Action items: Karthik — please consolidate the merchant tokens and upload the final mapping to the shared drive folder (link in my calendar invite). Rachel — propose a 30-min sync with AWS & CloudReseller tomorrow (Aug 8) to close the loop.

Marcus Lin
Director, Finance — Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Jamie Chen <aws-marketplace-billing@amazon.com>, Asha Rao <accounts@cloudreseller.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Aug 2028 16:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace usage allocation — July payout shortfall / entity split investigation

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick responses. Confirming next steps: 

• Karthik will upload the consolidated merchant token list and our internal entitlement mapping to the shared drive (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_redacted_shared_drive) by 8:30am PT on Aug 8.
• AWS (Jamie) will return the per-line CSV and invoice PDF (Case AMZ-MKT-168332) and confirm whether redistribution was accepted.
• CloudReseller (Asha) will share any notes from their redistribution submission and the allocation CSV they attached.
• Marcus to notify Accounting to provisionally hold €5,000 of the Aug payout pending final reconciliation.

I’ve scheduled a 30-min sync for Aug 8 09:00 PT — calendar invite sent to participants. Agenda: reconciling merchant tokens, expected timeline for redistribution, and VAT treatment confirmation for the three BrightWave EU accounts. Please upload any supporting files to the shared drive folder ahead of the call.

If AWS approves redistribution and issues adjustments, we’ll coordinate credit memos to affected buyers and update HubSpot (DEAL-7421) to reflect the corrected invoice numbers.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments uploaded: redwood-marketplace-usage-export-Jul-2028.csv, cloudreseller-allocation-Jul-2028.csv, aws-case-168332-invoice-lines.pdf
